svg.aria-label: wayland-wallpaperengine. Your Steam Wallpaper Engine wallpapers as a live desktop background on Linux Wayland, including GNOME. An animation shows the wallpaper freezing when an app takes focus: renderer CPU drops from 13 to 0 percent, GNOME Shell CPU from 22 to 3 percent, GPU from 71 to 7 percent, measured on an Intel iGPU.
